About me

The marketer behind the accounts

Md. Mostafijur Rahman
Dhaka, Bangladesh
Twitter Marketing Manager · Chatbot Developer · Digital Marketer

I'm a digital marketer, social media manager and chatbot developer with 4+ years of experience, specialising in X (Twitter) growth for crypto & NFT projects, ManyChat funnels and content that converts. Most of my work is in the crypto and NFT sector — a space where trust is everything and only real community survives — alongside skincare, wellness, rental and non-profit brands.

My approach is simple: show up every day. Consistent content in the brand's voice, genuine conversations in the niche, and design that stops the scroll.

No bots. No purchased followers. Growth that's slower to fake — and impossible to lose overnight.

Design is a craft I take seriously: after an early lesson in how much one visual can matter, I spent three years going deep on Canva — today, content and its graphics come from the same pair of hands, so nothing waits on a designer.

Add ManyChat chatbots to the mix and the system closes the loop: content brings the audience, engagement builds the trust, and funnels capture the lead.

FAQ

Questions clients ask first

How fast will I see growth on X?

Growth depends on your niche and starting point. Most clients see steadier engagement within the first few weeks of consistent, founder-led content and daily engagement.

Do you work with new crypto or NFT projects?

Yes — newly launched and launching projects are my speciality. I help founders build a credible, active X presence from day one.

Can you build a chatbot for lead capture?

Yes. I build ManyChat funnels that answer common questions and capture leads from your social channels automatically.
